briefing.bottom_line: ITC is delivering strong top-line and profit growth, driven by a 19% surge in its FMCG segment and robust free cash flow, but investors should note that total debt has increased nearly eight-fold this year. While the company remains highly profitable, the shift toward acquisitions and reliance on cigarette price hikes introduces new execution and volume risks that contrast with its historically conservative balance sheet.
